quote: Love, work, and knowledge are the wellsprings of our lives, they should also govern it.
author: Wilhelm Reich

quote: I love sharing my knowledge of hitting with others. Now coaches and players at all levels can learn my systematic approach to hitting a baseball with more consistency, mental strength and accuracy.
author: Dusty Baker

quote: I wanted to contribute my time, myself, my knowledge, my love, because Haiti is my everything.
author: Laurent Lamothe

quote: Enlightened leadership is spiritual if we understand spirituality not as some kind of religious dogma or ideology but as the domain of awareness where we experience values like truth, goodness, beauty, love and compassion, and also intuition, creativity, insight and focused attention.
author: Deepak Chopra

quote: I think we need the feminine qualities of leadership, which include attention to aesthetics and the environment, nurturing, affection, intuition and the qualities that make people feel safe and cared for.
author: Deepak Chopra

quote: All Americans and freedom-loving people around the world owe President Reagan our deepest gratitude for his strong, principled leadership that ended the Cold War and brought freedom to millions of people.
author: Jim Ramstad

quote: The atmosphere at my school was very competitive. Young girls were competing with each other every day for status, for leadership, for the affection of the teachers. I hated it.
author: Zhang Ziyi

quote: The ultimate lesson all of us have to learn is unconditional love, which includes not only others but ourselves as well.
author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quote: Study nature, love nature, stay close to nature. It will never fail you.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: I don't love studying. I hate studying. I like learning. Learning is beautiful.
author: Natalie Portman

quote: Never make your home in a place. Make a home for yourself inside your own head. You'll find what you need to furnish it - memory, friends you can trust, love of learning, and other such things. That way it will go with you wherever you journey.
author: Tad Williams

quote: A good teacher can inspire hope, ignite the imagination, and instill a love of learning.
author: Brad Henry

quote: The love of learning, the sequestered nooks, And all the sweet serenity of books.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: Even from their infancy we frame them to the sports of love: their instruction, behavior, attire, grace, learning and all their words azimuth only at love, respects only affection. Their nurses and their keepers imprint no other thing in them.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: We come to love not by finding a perfect person but by learning to see an imperfect person perfectly.
author: Sam Keen

quote: We are learning, too, that the love of beauty is one of Nature's greatest healers.
author: Ellsworth Huntington

quote: No, I got a GED in my 30s. My kids know that I never stop learning, and they know I love reading. I have books overflowing everywhere. I am current on today's events and I read the paper every day, and we talk about it, so they see that appetite.
author: Michael J. Fox

quote: Learning music by reading about it is like making love by mail.
author: Luciano Pavarotti

quote: Perhaps the mission of those who love mankind is to make people laugh at the truth, to make truth laugh, because the only truth lies in learning to free ourselves from insane passion for the truth.
author: Umberto Eco

quote: Narcissist: psychoanalytic term for the person who loves himself more than his analyst considered to be the manifestation of a dire mental disease whose successful treatment depends on the patient learning to love the analyst more and himself less.
author: Thomas Szasz

quote: I love learning new techniques.
author: David Bailey

quote: Since we can't know what knowledge will be most needed in the future, it is senseless to try to teach it in advance. Instead, we should try to turn out people who love learning so much and learn so well that they will be able to learn whatever needs to be learned.
author: John Holt

quote: My life path has been a blessing and a great learning experience. Skateboarding is my passion and I don't see that changing. When I'm not skating, I love to surf. I'm open to the new experiences and opportunities.
author: Ryan Sheckler

quote: You should be having more fun in high school, exploring things because you want to explore them and learning because you love learning-not worrying about competition.
author: Maya Lin

quote: I love nature and enjoy learning new skills.
author: Leona Lewis

quote: What matters to me is learning and growing, and getting to do what I love to do. As long as I can do that, I'm happy.
author: Jeremy Renner

quote: The hardest of all is learning to be a well of affection, and not a fountain to show them we love them not when we feel like it, but when they do.
author: Nan Fairbrother

quote: The greatest gift that Oxford gives her sons is, I truly believe, a genial irreverence toward learning, and from that irreverence love may spring.
author: Robertson Davies

quote: A love of books, of holding a book, turning its pages, looking at its pictures, and living its fascinating stories goes hand-in-hand with a love of learning.
author: Laura Bush

quote: I'd love to go to fashion week! I'm learning more about designers, thanks to 'Pretty Little Liars'' costume designer, Mandi Line.
author: Lucy Hale

quote: I'd love to do a romantic comedy. And perhaps, if the character was right and I had a good gut instinct, a Bollywood movie. And I'd love to direct. One day. I'm learning a lot on the set of 'The Good Wife.'
author: Archie Panjabi

quote: I've always had better luck learning things on my own. And I really love the challenge of doing it yourself and kind of being alone against the system.
author: Oren Peli

quote: I felt that if there wasn't going to be a good opportunity, then I would just go back to second units which I love, keep working with great directors, keep learning and knowing that the opportunity would come when the time was right.
author: David R. Ellis

quote: When I started learning the cello, I fell in love with the instrument because it seemed like a voice - my voice.
author: Mstislav Rostropovich

quote: Probably having fallen in love with music and movies at a young age and then first learning about writing by kind of following the path of writers like Dave Marsh and Lester Bangs and being a rock journalist.
author: Cameron Crowe

quote: I love learning, and I think that curiosity is a wonderful gift.
author: Andie MacDowell

quote: I love the work, I love being in front of the camera and working with actors and directors and creating something. For me, it's like learning everyday.
author: Estella Warren

quote: The rite of passage of learning to build a fire that will burn all night with one match is not an insignificant one in my husband's family, and I grew up camping and backpacking. I love to camp.
author: Sarah Wayne Callies

quote: I'd love to be a saxophonist. I don't know why, but I pretend I'm the saxophonist when I listen to music. I have about as much chance playing the sax as I do learning how to fly.
author: Richard Price

quote: I love learning about different dialects and I own all sorts of regional and time-period slang dictionaries. I often browse through relevant ones while writing a story. I also read a lot of diaries and oral histories.
author: Ron Rash

quote: I think I'd like to stay anchoring because, number one, I'm learning a lot, and I love it when I'm learning. And number two, I also have the luxury of a stable life.
author: Linda Vester

quote: I love talking about women because they are a constant study and you're always learning.
author: Mario Lopez

quote: Young children were sooner allured by love, than driven by beating, to attain good learning.
author: Roger Ascham

quote: In mine opinion, love is fitter than fear, gentleness better than beating, to bring up a child rightly in learning.
author: Roger Ascham

quote: I love learning new things that will never be put to practical use.
author: Jackson Rathbone

quote: Love is moral even without legal marriage, but marriage is immoral without love.
author: Ellen Key

quote: I love the new legal immigrants they want their kids to be safe just like I do.
author: Lou Barletta

quote: Life is a song - sing it. Life is a game - play it. Life is a challenge - meet it. Life is a dream - realize it. Life is a sacrifice - offer it. Life is love - enjoy it.
author: Sai Baba

quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: I love those who yearn for the impossible.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: I love life because what more is there?
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: Who will tell whether one happy moment of love or the joy of breathing or walking on a bright morning and smelling the fresh air, is not worth all the suffering and effort which life implies.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Doing what you love is the cornerstone of having abundance in your life.
author: Wayne Dyer

quote: The story of life is quicker then the blink of an eye, the story of love is hello, goodbye.
author: Jimi Hendrix

quote: I have found that if you love life, life will love you back.
author: Arthur Rubinstein

quote: Life in abundance comes only through great love.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: The greatest pleasure of life is love.
author: Euripides

quote: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: The main facts in human life are five: birth, food, sleep, love and death.
author: E. M. Forster

quote: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Where there is love there is life.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: Choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life.
author: Confucius

quote: Love is our true destiny. We do not find the meaning of life by ourselves alone - we find it with another.
author: Thomas Merton

quote: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Of life's two chief prizes, beauty and truth, I found the first in a loving heart and the second in a laborer's hand.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: You can't stop loving or wanting to love because when its right it's the best thing in the world. When you're in a relationship and its good, even if nothing else in your life is right, you feel like your whole world is complete.
author: Keith Sweat

quote: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: Love is life. And if you miss love, you miss life.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: The things that will destroy America are prosperity-at-any-price, peace-at-any-price, safety-first instead of duty-first, the love of soft living, and the get-rich-quick theory of life.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: I love sleep. My life has the tendency to fall apart when I'm awake, you know?
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: So long as the memory of certain beloved friends lives in my heart, I shall say that life is good.
author: Helen Keller

quote: Life without love is like a tree without blossoms or fruit.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. And the only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle. As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: There are four questions of value in life... What is sacred? Of what is the spirit made? What is worth living for, and what is worth dying for? The answer to each is the same. Only love.
author: Johnny Depp

quote: Once in his life, every man is entitled to fall madly in love with a gorgeous redhead.
author: Lucille Ball

quote: I guess I have always been deeply terrified to really be someone's wife since I know from life one cannot love another, ever, really.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: There is a very fine line between loving life and being greedy for it.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: I'm not claiming divinity. I've never claimed purity of soul. I've never claimed to have the answers to life. I only put out songs and answer questions as honestly as I can... But I still believe in peace, love and understanding.
author: John Lennon

quote: You will find as you look back upon your life that the moments when you have truly lived are the moments when you have done things in the spirit of love.
author: Henry Drummond

quote: Presents don't really mean much to me. I don't want to sound mawkish, but - it was the realization that I have a great many people in my life who really love me, and who I really love.
author: Gabriel Byrne

quote: Throw your dreams into space like a kite, and you do not know what it will bring back, a new life, a new friend, a new love, a new country.
author: Anais Nin

quote: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that is the stuff life is made of.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: Success comes from taking the initiative and following up... persisting... eloquently expressing the depth of your love. What simple action could you take today to produce a new momentum toward success in your life?
author: Tony Robbins

quote: I swear, by my life and my love of it, that I will never live for the sake of another man, nor ask another man to live for mine.
author: Ayn Rand

quote: Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
author: Joseph Addison

quote: Life began with waking up and loving my mother's face.
author: George Eliot

quote: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: Don't ignore the past, but deal with it, on your own pace. Once you deal with it, you are free of it and you are free to embrace your life and be a happy loving person because if you don't, the past will come back to haunt and keep coming back to haunt you.
author: Boris Kodjoe

quote: I just don't know how to deal with so many people giving me that much affection. I never had that in my life.
author: Tupac Shakur

quote: About all you can do in life is be who you are. Some people will love you for you. Most will love you for what you can do for them, and some won't like you at all.
author: Rita Mae Brown

quote: I'm back to doing everything I used to, loving life as ever.
author: Donna Mills

quote: Infuse your life with action. Don't wait for it to happen. Make it happen. Make your own future. Make your own hope. Make your own love. And whatever your beliefs, honor your creator, not by passively waiting for grace to come down from upon high, but by doing what you can to make grace happen... yourself, right now, right down here on Earth.
author: Bradley Whitford

quote: It's funny how most people love the dead, once you're dead your made for life.
author: Jimi Hendrix

quote: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: The struggle of my life created empathy - I could relate to pain, being abandoned, having people not love me.
author: Oprah Winfrey

quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: All my life affection has been showered upon me, and every forward step I have made has been taken in spite of it.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Above our life we love a steadfast friend.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Life is short and we have never too much time for gladdening the hearts of those who are travelling the dark journey with us. Oh be swift to love, make haste to be kind.
author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quote: I believe that every single event in life happens in an opportunity to choose love over fear.
author: Oprah Winfrey

quote: This is love: to fly toward a secret sky, to cause a hundred veils to fall each moment. First to let go of life. Finally, to take a step without feet.
author: Rumi

quote: My trust in a higher power that wants me to survive and have love in my life, is what keeps me moving forward.
author: Kenny Loggins

quote: Let love flow so that it cleanses the world. Then man can live in peace, instead of the state of turmoil he has created through his past ways of life, with all those material interests and earthly ambitions.
author: Sai Baba

quote: There is a fountain of youth: it is your mind, your talents, the creativity you bring to your life and the lives of people you love. When you learn to tap this source, you will truly have defeated age.
author: Sophia Loren

quote: Love, we say, is life but love without hope and faith is agonizing death.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: It's funny the way most people love the dead. Once you are dead, you are made for life.
author: Jimi Hendrix

quote: Do what you love to do and give it your very best. Whether it's business or baseball, or the theater, or any field. If you don't love what you're doing and you can't give it your best, get out of it. Life is too short. You'll be an old man before you know it.
author: Al Lopez

quote: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, indignation and compassion.
author: Simone de Beauvoir

quote: Music is love, love is music, music is life, and I love my life. Thank you and good night.
author: A. J. McLean

quote: A dog will teach you unconditional love. If you can have that in your life, things won't be too bad.
author: Robert Wagner

quote: We must declare ourselves, become known allow the world to discover this subterranean life of ours which connects kings and farm boys, artists and clerks. Let them see that the important thing is not the object of love, but the emotion itself.
author: Gore Vidal

quote: Love is the greatest refreshment in life.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: If you find someone you love in your life, then hang on to that love.
author: Princess Diana

quote: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Friends can help each other. A true friend is someone who lets you have total freedom to be yourself - and especially to feel. Or, not feel. Whatever you happen to be feeling at the moment is fine with them. That's what real love amounts to - letting a person be what he really is.
author: Jim Morrison

quote: Sometimes the heart sees what is invisible to the eye.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
author: Aristotle

quote: I have decided to stick with love. Hate is too great a burden to bear.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Affection is responsible for nine-tenths of whatever solid and durable happiness there is in our lives.
author: C. S. Lewis

quote: Immature love says: 'I love you because I need you.' Mature love says 'I need you because I love you.'
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Where there is love there is life.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: We're born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for the moment that we're not alone.
author: Orson Welles

quote: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: A man reserves his true and deepest love not for the species of woman in whose company he finds himself electrified and enkindled, but for that one in whose company he may feel tenderly drowsy.
author: George Jean Nathan

quote: I have found the paradox, that if you love until it hurts, there can be no more hurt, only more love.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: For it was not into my ear you whispered, but into my heart. It was not my lips you kissed, but my soul.
author: Judy Garland

quote: A kiss is a lovely trick designed by nature to stop speech when words become superfluous.
author: Ingrid Bergman

quote: Let us always meet each other with smile, for the smile is the beginning of love.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: A flower cannot blossom without sunshine, and man cannot live without love.
author: Max Muller

quote: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
author: A. A. Milne

quote: Gravitation is not responsible for people falling in love.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Love begins at home, and it is not how much we do... but how much love we put in that action.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: Love does not begin and end the way we seem to think it does. Love is a battle, love is a war love is a growing up.
author: James A. Baldwin

quote: Can miles truly separate you from friends... If you want to be with someone you love, aren't you already there?
author: Richard Bach

quote: A woman knows the face of the man she loves as a sailor knows the open sea.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: A man is already halfway in love with any woman who listens to him.
author: Brendan Francis

quote: Love is a force more formidable than any other. It is invisible - it cannot be seen or measured, yet it is powerful enough to transform you in a moment, and offer you more joy than any material possession could.
author: Barbara de Angelis

quote: Time is too slow for those who wait, too swift for those who fear, too long for those who grieve, too short for those who rejoice, but for those who love, time is eternity.
author: Henry Van Dyke

quote: Do all things with love.
author: Og Mandino

quote: A kiss makes the heart young again and wipes out the years.
author: Rupert Brooke

quote: Absence diminishes mediocre passions and increases great ones, as the wind extinguishes candles and fans fires.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: I was born with an enormous need for affection, and a terrible need to give it.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: At the touch of love everyone becomes a poet.
author: Plato

quote: Love is our true destiny. We do not find the meaning of life by ourselves alone - we find it with another.
author: Thomas Merton

quote: Love yourself first and everything else falls into line. You really have to love yourself to get anything done in this world.
author: Lucille Ball

quote: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Love is a better teacher than duty.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Come live in my heart, and pay no rent.
author: Samuel Lover

quote: Love is always bestowed as a gift - freely, willingly and without expectation. We don't love to be loved we love to love.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: Love is like war: easy to begin but very hard to stop.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: If you press me to say why I loved him, I can say no more than because he was he, and I was I.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: The hunger for love is much more difficult to remove than the hunger for bread.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: Love is life. And if you miss love, you miss life.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: What we have once enjoyed we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
author: Helen Keller

quote: As soon go kindle fire with snow, as seek to quench the fire of love with words.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Faith makes all things possible... love makes all things easy.
author: Dwight L. Moody

quote: Friendship often ends in love but love in friendship - never.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: A very small degree of hope is sufficient to cause the birth of love.
author: Stendhal

quote: Once the realization is accepted that even between the closest human beings infinite distances continue, a wonderful living side by side can grow, if they succeed in loving the distance between them which makes it possible for each to see the other whole against the sky.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: The best proof of love is trust.
author: Joyce Brothers

quote: A part of kindness consists in loving people more than they deserve.
author: Joseph Joubert

quote: Love isn't something you find. Love is something that finds you.
author: Loretta Young

quote: I like not only to be loved, but also to be told I am loved.
author: George Eliot

quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: A pair of powerful spectacles has sometimes sufficed to cure a person in love.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Life without love is like a tree without blossoms or fruit.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: A loving heart is the truest wisdom.
author: Charles Dickens

quote: All my life, my heart has yearned for a thing I cannot name.
author: Andre Breton

quote: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Love can sometimes be magic. But magic can sometimes... just be an illusion.
author: Javan

quote: First love is only a little foolishness and a lot of curiosity.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Love makes your soul crawl out from its hiding place.
author: Zora Neale Hurston

quote: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
author: Robert Frost

quote: I can live without money, but I cannot live without love.
author: Judy Garland

quote: Love is the flower you've got to let grow.
author: John Lennon

quote: True love is like ghosts, which everyone talks about and few have seen.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: The hours I spend with you I look upon as sort of a perfumed garden, a dim twilight, and a fountain singing to it. You and you alone make me feel that I am alive. Other men it is said have seen angels, but I have seen thee and thou art enough.
author: George Edward Moore

quote: All love shifts and changes. I don't know if you can be wholeheartedly in love all the time.
author: Julie Andrews

quote: Love is a smoke made with the fume of sighs.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quote: Everything is clearer when you're in love.
author: John Lennon

quote: The way to love anything is to realize that it may be lost.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: We waste time looking for the perfect lover, instead of creating the perfect love.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: I was about half in love with her by the time we sat down. That's the thing about girls. Every time they do something pretty... you fall half in love with them, and then you never know where the hell you are.
author: J. D. Salinger

quote: Who, being loved, is poor?
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Love is a game that two can play and both win.
author: Eva Gabor

quote: For small creatures such as we the vastness is bearable only through love.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: The one thing we can never get enough of is love. And the one thing we never give enough is love.
author: Henry Miller

quote: Love is when the other person's happiness is more important than your own.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quote: The giving of love is an education in itself.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quote: All mankind love a lover.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: You will find as you look back upon your life that the moments when you have truly lived are the moments when you have done things in the spirit of love.
author: Henry Drummond

quote: If you wish to be loved, show more of your faults than your virtues.
author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quote: Don't brood. Get on with living and loving. You don't have forever.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: The moment you have in your heart this extraordinary thing called love and feel the depth, the delight, the ecstasy of it, you will discover that for you the world is transformed.
author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

quote: It is sad not to love, but it is much sadder not to be able to love.
author: Miguel de Unamuno

quote: Love is of all passions the strongest, for it attacks simultaneously the head, the heart and the senses.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: The art of love is largely the art of persistence.
author: Albert Ellis

quote: Love is a friendship set to music.
author: Joseph Campbell

quote: There is no remedy for love but to love more.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: If you want to be loved, be lovable.
author: Ovid

quote: Love is the beauty of the soul.
author: Saint Augustine

quote: Love possesses not nor will it be possessed, for love is sufficient unto love.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love is the triumph of imagination over intelligence.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: To say 'I love you' one must first be able to say the 'I.'
author: Ayn Rand

quote: Before I met my husband, I'd never fallen in love. I'd stepped in it a few times.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: If you would be loved, love, and be loveable.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: Love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is done well.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: Love does not dominate it cultivates.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Only do what your heart tells you.
author: Princess Diana

quote: You never lose by loving. You always lose by holding back.
author: Barbara de Angelis

quote: Love... it surrounds every being and extends slowly to embrace all that shall be.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love is a canvas furnished by nature and embroidered by imagination.
author: Voltaire

quote: It's useless to hold a person to anything he says while he's in love, drunk, or running for office.
author: Shirley MacLaine

quote: Love is a gross exaggeration of the difference between one person and everybody else.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: What love we've given, we'll have forever. What love we fail to give, will be lost for all eternity.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: One is loved because one is loved. No reason is needed for loving.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: Love is being stupid together.
author: Paul Valery

quote: Love is when you meet someone who tells you something new about yourself.
author: Andre Breton

quote: It is difficult to know at what moment love begins it is less difficult to know that it has begun.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: How absurd and delicious it is to be in love with somebody younger than yourself. Everybody should try it.
author: Barbara Pym

quote: In love the paradox occurs that two beings become one and yet remain two.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: When love is not madness, it is not love.
author: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

quote: The love we give away is the only love we keep.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: Love is an act of endless forgiveness, a tender look which becomes a habit.
author: Peter Ustinov

quote: Blessed is the influence of one true, loving human soul on another.
author: George Eliot

quote: A kiss is a rosy dot over the 'i' of loving.
author: Cyrano de Bergerac

quote: Love is the only sane and satisfactory answer to the problem of human existence.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Absence - that common cure of love.
author: Lord Byron

quote: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: The only abnormality is the incapacity to love.
author: Anais Nin

quote: There is no disguise which can hide love for long where it exists, or simulate it where it does not.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: Love consists in this, that two solitudes protect and touch and greet each other.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: Be of love a little more careful than of anything.
author: e. e. cummings

quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: Emily Bronte

quote: Love takes off masks that we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.
author: James A. Baldwin

quote: A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
author: Jesus Christ

quote: Love is supreme and unconditional like is nice but limited.
author: Duke Ellington

quote: Gestures, in love, are incomparably more attractive, effective and valuable than words.
author: Francois Rabelais

quote: Looking back, I have this to regret, that too often when I loved, I did not say so.
author: David Grayson

quote: I love that feeling of being in love, the effect of having butterflies when you wake up in the morning. That is special.
author: Jennifer Aniston

quote: I believe in the compelling power of love. I do not understand it. I believe it to be the most fragrant blossom of all this thorny existence.
author: Theodore Dreiser

quote: Lord, grant that I might not so much seek to be loved as to love.
author: Francis of Assisi

quote: Sometimes it's a form of love just to talk to somebody that you have nothing in common with and still be fascinated by their presence.
author: David Byrne

quote: There is a woman at the begining of all great things.
author: Alphonse de Lamartine

quote: Love knows not distance it hath no continent its eyes are for the stars.
author: Gilbert Parker

quote: The sweetest of all sounds is that of the voice of the woman we love.
author: Jean de la Bruyere

quote: The degree of loving is measured by the degree of giving.
author: Edwin Louis Cole

quote: People think love is an emotion. Love is good sense.
author: Ken Kesey

quote: Love is the only reality and it is not a mere sentiment. It is the ultimate truth that lies at the heart of creation.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

quote: Love is the greatest refreshment in life.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: There is only one kind of love, but there are a thousand imitations.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: Love is the delusion that one woman differs from another.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: If you wished to be loved, love.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quote: Love is my religion - I could die for it.
author: John Keats

quote: Tell me who admires and loves you, and I will tell you who you are.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

quote: Love shall be our token love be yours and love be mine.
author: Christina Rossetti

quote: He is not a lover who does not love forever.
author: Euripides

quote: Love is the hardest habit to break, and the most difficult to satisfy.
author: Drew Barrymore

quote: When we are in love we seem to ourselves quite different from what we were before.
author: Blaise Pascal

quote: The most powerful weapon on earth is the human soul on fire.
author: Ferdinand Foch

quote: Love is all we have, the only way that each can help the other.
author: Euripides

quote: Choose your love, Love your choice.
author: Thomas S. Monson

quote: Falling in love consists merely in uncorking the imagination and bottling the common sense.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: Love is an emotion experienced by the many and enjoyed by the few.
author: George Jean Nathan

quote: If you could only love enough, you could be the most powerful person in the world.
author: Emmet Fox

quote: Love means to commit yourself without guarantee.
author: Anne Campbell

quote: Follow love and it will flee, flee love and it will follow thee.
author: John Gay

quote: The way to know life is to love many things.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: Your words are my food, your breath my wine. You are everything to me.
author: Sarah Bernhardt

quote: The fact is that love is of two kinds, one which commands, and one which obeys. The two are quite distinct, and the passion to which the one gives rise is not the passion of the other.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: Love is only a dirty trick played on us to achieve continuation of the species.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: Love takes up where knowledge leaves off.
author: Thomas Aquinas

quote: Fortune and love favor the brave.
author: Ovid

quote: Each moment of a happy lover's hour is worth an age of dull and common life.
author: Aphra Behn

quote: Love is suffering. One side always loves more.
author: Catherine Deneuve

quote: Love is what you've been through with somebody.
author: James Thurber

quote: Love looks through a telescope envy, through a microscope.
author: Josh Billings

quote: Love in its essence is spiritual fire.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quote: There are never enough I Love You's.
author: Lenny Bruce

quote: Love is always being given where it is not required.
author: E. M. Forster

quote: Friendship is Love without his wings!
author: Lord Byron

quote: Come live with me and be my love, And we will all the pleasures prove, That valleys, groves, hills, and fields, Woods, or steepy mountain yields.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: The truth is that there is only one terminal dignity - love. And the story of a love is not important - what is important is that one is capable of love. It is perhaps the only glimpse we are permitted of eternity.
author: Helen Hayes

quote: We are all born for love. It is the principle of existence, and its only end.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: Love is the poetry of the senses.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: There is always something left to love. And if you ain't learned that, you ain't learned nothing.
author: Lorraine Hansberry

quote: Love means to love that which is unlovable or it is no virtue at all.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: People who throw kisses are hopelessly lazy.
author: Bob Hope

quote: Love is not only something you feel, it is something you do.
author: David Wilkerson

quote: Love is the great miracle cure. Loving ourselves works miracles in our lives.
author: Louise L. Hay

quote: In every living thing there is the desire for love.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: Love is but the discovery of ourselves in others, and the delight in the recognition.
author: Alexander Smith

quote: For love is immortality.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote: We may give without loving, but we cannot love without giving.
author: Bernard Meltzer

quote: Love conquers all.
author: Virgil

quote: Sometimes it's hard to be a woman giving all your love to just one man.
author: Tammy Wynette

quote: To love abundantly is to live abundantly, and to love forever is to live forever.
author: Henry Drummond

quote: Love is that splendid triggering of human vitality the supreme activity which nature affords anyone for going out of himself toward someone else.
author: Jose Ortega y Gasset

quote: When you love a man, he becomes more than a body. His physical limbs expand, and his outline recedes, vanishes. He is rich and sweet and right. He is part of the world, the atmosphere, the blue sky and the blue water.
author: Gwendolyn Brooks

quote: If you can learn to love yourself and all the flaws, you can love other people so much better. And that makes you so happy.
author: Kristin Chenoweth

quote: Say what you will, 'tis better to be left than never to have been loved.
author: William Congreve

quote: Sympathy constitutes friendship but in love there is a sort of antipathy, or opposing passion. Each strives to be the other, and both together make up one whole.
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quote: Love is the power to see similarity in the dissimilar.
author: Theodor Adorno

quote: If thou must love me, let it be for naught except for love's sake only.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: Take away love and our earth is a tomb.
author: Robert Browning

quote: Love is the word used to label the sexual excitement of the young, the habituation of the middle-aged, and the mutual dependence of the old.
author: John Ciardi

quote: Love is the child of illusion and the parent of disillusion.
author: Miguel de Unamuno

quote: Do you have to have a reason for loving?
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: The first magic of love is our ignorance that it can ever end.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: Love's greatest gift is its ability to make everything it touches sacred.
author: Barbara de Angelis

quote: The quarrels of lovers are the renewal of love.
author: Jean Racine

quote: When you're in love you never really know whether your elation comes from the qualities of the one you love, or if it attributes them to her whether the light which surrounds her like a halo comes from you, from her, or from the meeting of your sparks.
author: Natalie Clifford Barney

quote: What the world really needs is more love and less paper work.
author: Pearl Bailey

quote: Woe to the man whose heart has not learned while young to hope, to love - and to put its trust in life.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: Let no one who loves be unhappy, even love unreturned has its rainbow.
author: James M. Barrie

quote: I don't know that love changes. People change. Circumstances change.
author: Nicholas Sparks

quote: No one has ever loved anyone the way everyone wants to be loved.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

quote: He who loves, flies, runs, and rejoices he is free and nothing holds him back.
author: Henri Matisse

quote: Love is the only gold.
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quote: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
author: David Viscott

quote: It is easier to love humanity as a whole than to love one's neighbor.
author: Eric Hoffer

quote: Though lovers be lost love shall not.
author: Dylan Thomas

quote: Nobody has ever measured, not even poets, how much the heart can hold.
author: Zelda Fitzgerald

quote: When you love someone all your saved up wishes start coming out.
author: Elizabeth Bowen

quote: Love means not ever having to say you're sorry.
author: Erich Segal

quote: There is no limit to the power of loving.
author: John Morton

quote: Love you will find only where you may show yourself weak without provoking strength.
author: Theodor Adorno

quote: Love is a springtime plant that perfumes everything with its hope, even the ruins to which it clings.
author: Gustave Flaubert

quote: O, thou art fairer than the evening air clad in the beauty of a thousand stars.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Love is a mutual self-giving which ends in self-recovery.
author: Fulton J. Sheen

quote: To love for the sake of being loved is human, but to love for the sake of loving is angelic.
author: Alphonse de Lamartine

quote: You don't want to love - your eternal and abnormal craving is to be loved. You aren't positive, you're negative. You absorb, absorb, as if you must fill yourself up with love, because you've got a shortage somewhere.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: There is more pleasure in loving than in being beloved.
author: Thomas Fuller

quote: When love is at its best, one loves so much that he cannot forget.
author: Helen Hunt Jackson

quote: Love is like a faucet, it turns off and on.
author: Billie Holiday

quote: More than kisses, letters mingle souls.
author: John Donne

quote: Stand by your man. Give him two arms to cling to and something warm to come to.
author: Tammy Wynette

quote: Love is metaphysical gravity.
author: R. Buckminster Fuller

quote: There is room in the smallest cottage for a happy loving pair.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: Who loves, raves.
author: Lord Byron

quote: With our love, we could save the world.
author: George Harrison

quote: Pains of love be sweeter far than all other pleasures are.
author: John Dryden

quote: To good and true love fear is forever affixed.
author: Francois Rabelais

quote: What is love? It is the morning and the evening star.
author: Sinclair Lewis

quote: Ultimately love is everything.
author: M. Scott Peck

quote: True love is quiescent, except in the nascent moments of true humility.
author: Bryant H. McGill

quote: Only love interests me, and I am only in contact with things that revolve around love.
author: Marc Chagall

quote: You don't have to go looking for love when it's where you come from.
author: Werner Erhard

quote: It is very easy to love alone.
author: Gertrude Stein

quote: Who so loves believes the impossible.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: Only divine love bestows the keys of knowledge.
author: Arthur Rimbaud

quote: The richest love is that which submits to the arbitration of time.
author: Lawrence Durrell

quote: We perceive when love begins and when it declines by our embarrassment when alone together.
author: Jean de la Bruyere

quote: Love ceases to be a pleasure when it ceases to be a secret.
author: Aphra Behn

quote: All love is vanquished by a succeeding love.
author: Ovid

quote: We can only learn to love by loving.
author: Iris Murdoch

quote: We are most alive when we're in love.
author: John Updike

quote: Who ever loved that loved not at first sight?
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Love is when he gives you a piece of your soul, that you never knew was missing.
author: Torquato Tasso

quote: Love is an energy which exists of itself. It is its own value.
author: Thornton Wilder

quote: In love there are two things - bodies and words.
author: Joyce Carol Oates

quote: We love but once, for once only are we perfectly equipped for loving.
author: Cyril Connolly

quote: I long for the raised voice, the howl of rage or love.
author: Leslie Fiedler

quote: Love is love's reward.
author: John Dryden

quote: But love's a malady without a cure.
author: John Dryden

quote: Love is much nicer to be in than an automobile accident, a tight girdle, a higher tax bracket or a holding pattern over Philadelphia.
author: Judith Viorst

quote: Is it not by love alone that we succeed in penetrating to the very essence of being?
author: Igor Stravinsky

quote: Who would give a law to lovers? Love is unto itself a higher law.
author: Boethius

quote: Love is blind.
author: Geoffrey Chaucer

quote: When we lose one we love, our bitterest tears are called forth by the memory of hours when we loved not enough.
author: Maurice Maeterlinck

quote: The cure for all the ills and wrongs, the cares, the sorrows, and the crimes of humanity, all lie in the one word 'love'. It is the divine vitality that everywhere produces and restores life.
author: Lydia M. Child

quote: Oh, love will make a dog howl in rhyme.
author: Francis Beaumont

quote: Love is a hole in the heart.
author: Ben Hecht

quote: Love is the magician that pulls man out of his own hat.
author: Ben Hecht

quote: In our life there is a single color, as on an artist's palette, which provides the meaning of life and art. It is the color of love.
author: Marc Chagall

quote: To enlarge or illustrate this power and effect of love is to set a candle in the sun.
author: Robert Burton

quote: One must not trifle with love.
author: Alfred de Musset

quote: Darkness cannot drive out darkness only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate only love can do that.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Life is a song - sing it. Life is a game - play it. Life is a challenge - meet it. Life is a dream - realize it. Life is a sacrifice - offer it. Life is love - enjoy it.
author: Sai Baba

quote: We must develop and maintain the capacity to forgive. He who is devoid of the power to forgive is devoid of the power to love. There is some good in the worst of us and some evil in the best of us. When we discover this, we are less prone to hate our enemies.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: When the power of love overcomes the love of power the world will know peace.
author: Jimi Hendrix

quote: You can search throughout the entire universe for someone who is more deserving of your love and affection than you are yourself, and that person is not to be found anywhere. You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe deserve your love and affection.
author: Buddha

quote: Choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life.
author: Confucius

quote: A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

quote: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: I refuse to accept the view that mankind is so tragically bound to the starless midnight of racism and war that the bright daybreak of peace and brotherhood can never become a reality... I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: All major religious traditions carry basically the same message, that is love, compassion and forgiveness the important thing is they should be part of our daily lives.
author: Dalai Lama

quote: I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality. This is why right, temporarily defeated, is stronger than evil triumphant.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: To love beauty is to see light.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power. They speak more eloquently than ten thousand tongues. They are the messengers of overwhelming grief, of deep contrition, and of unspeakable love.
author: Washington Irving

quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Love and compassion are necessities, not luxuries. Without them humanity cannot survive.
author: Dalai Lama

quote: Don't aim for success if you want it just do what you love and believe in, and it will come naturally.
author: David Frost

quote: It is easy to hate and it is difficult to love. This is how the whole scheme of things works. All good things are difficult to achieve and bad things are very easy to get.
author: Confucius

quote: I love people who make me laugh. I honestly think it's the thing I like most, to laugh. It cures a multitude of ills. It's probably the most important thing in a person.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive - to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: The love of family and the admiration of friends is much more important than wealth and privilege.
author: Charles Kuralt

quote: Man must evolve for all human conflict a method which rejects revenge, aggression and retaliation. The foundation of such a method is love.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: There can be no deep disappointment where there is not deep love.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Love begins by taking care of the closest ones - the ones at home.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: If music be the food of love, play on.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: If you have only one smile in you give it to the people you love.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Love is the only force capable of transforming an enemy into friend.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Have we not come to such an impasse in the modern world that we must love our enemies - or else? The chain reaction of evil - hate begetting hate, wars producing more wars - must be broken, or else we shall be plunged into the dark abyss of annihilation.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love this is the eternal rule.
author: Buddha

quote: All you need is love. But a little chocolate now and then doesn't hurt.
author: Charles M. Schulz

quote: Happiness cannot be traveled to, owned, earned, worn or consumed. Happiness is the spiritual experience of living every minute with love, grace, and gratitude.
author: Denis Waitley

quote: I love those who can smile in trouble, who can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but they whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves their conduct, will pursue their principles unto death.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: Before marriage, a girl has to make love to a man to hold him. After marriage, she has to hold him to make love to him.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: It may be true that the law cannot make a man love me, but it can keep him from lynching me, and I think that's pretty important.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: At the center of non-violence stands the principle of love.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
author: Euripides

quote: Let us not be satisfied with just giving money. Money is not enough, money can be got, but they need your hearts to love them. So, spread your love everywhere you go.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: You can't stop loving or wanting to love because when its right it's the best thing in the world. When you're in a relationship and its good, even if nothing else in your life is right, you feel like your whole world is complete.
author: Keith Sweat

quote: A coward is incapable of exhibiting love it is the prerogative of the brave.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: You can't blame gravity for falling in love.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: If you love someone, set them free. If they come back they're yours if they don't they never were.
author: Richard Bach

quote: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: If you love somebody, let them go, for if they return, they were always yours. And if they don't, they never were.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: I love you when you bow in your mosque, kneel in your temple, pray in your church. For you and I are sons of one religion, and it is the spirit.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: I say what I want to say and do what I want to do. There's no in between. People will either love you for it or hate you for it.
author: Eminem

quote: It is not enough to say we must not wage war. It is necessary to love peace and sacrifice for it.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quote: You, yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
author: Buddha

quote: People love chopping wood. In this activity one immediately sees results.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: The foundation stones for a balanced success are honesty, character, integrity, faith, love and loyalty.
author: Zig Ziglar

quote: Love is friendship that has caught fire. It is quiet understanding, mutual confidence, sharing and forgiving. It is loyalty through good and bad times. It settles for less than perfection and makes allowances for human weaknesses.
author: Ann Landers

quote: If you want a love message to be heard, it has got to be sent out. To keep a lamp burning, we have to keep putting oil in it.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own... Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy.
author: Robert A. Heinlein

quote: Intense love does not measure, it just gives.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: But let there be spaces in your togetherness and let the winds of the heavens dance between you. Love one another but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Even the rich are hungry for love, for being cared for, for being wanted, for having someone to call their own.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: Love is a fruit in season at all times, and within reach of every hand.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: I love mirrors. They let one pass through the surface of things.
author: Claude Chabrol

quote: Be Impeccable With Your Word. Speak with integrity. Say only what you mean. Avoid using the word to speak against yourself or to gossip about others. Use the power of your word in the direction of truth and love.
author: Miguel Angel Ruiz

quote: The beginning of love is to let those we love be perfectly themselves, and not to twist them to fit our own image. Otherwise we love only the reflection of ourselves we find in them.
author: Thomas Merton

quote: If we listened to our intellect, we'd never have a love affair. We'd never have a friendship. We'd never go into business, because we'd be cynical. Well, that's nonsense. You've got to jump off cliffs all the time and build your wings on the way down.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: Kindness in words creates confidence. Kindness in thinking creates profoundness. Kindness in giving creates love.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Anyway, no drug, not even alcohol, causes the fundamental ills of society. If we're looking for the source of our troubles, we shouldn't test people for drugs, we should test them for stupidity, ignorance, greed and love of power.
author: P. J. O'Rourke

quote: The beauty of a woman must be seen from in her eyes, because that is the doorway to her heart, the place where love resides.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: And ever has it been known that love knows not its own depth until the hour of separation.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: The things that will destroy America are prosperity-at-any-price, peace-at-any-price, safety-first instead of duty-first, the love of soft living, and the get-rich-quick theory of life.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Absence from those we love is self from self - a deadly banishment.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: I honestly think it is better to be a failure at something you love than to be a success at something you hate.
author: George Burns

quote: Love is the ability and willingness to allow those that you care for to be what they choose for themselves without any insistence that they satisfy you.
author: Wayne Dyer

quote: Men always want to be a woman's first love - women like to be a man's last romance.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Love is like a beautiful flower which I may not touch, but whose fragrance makes the garden a place of delight just the same.
author: Helen Keller

quote: I love sleep. My life has the tendency to fall apart when I'm awake, you know?
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: If we lose love and self respect for each other, this is how we finally die.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: The course of true love never did run smooth.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: I know of only one duty, and that is to love.
author: Albert Camus

quote: One should always be in love. That is the reason one should never marry.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: We've got this gift of love, but love is like a precious plant. You can't just accept it and leave it in the cupboard or just think it's going to get on by itself. You've got to keep watering it. You've got to really look after it and nurture it.
author: John Lennon

quote: A man can be happy with any woman, as long as he does not love her.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: The greatest gift that you can give to others is the gift of unconditional love and acceptance.
author: Brian Tracy

quote: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. And the only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle. As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: Forgiveness is the final form of love.
author: Reinhold Niebuhr

quote: The most important thing a father can do for his children is to love their mother.
author: Theodore Hesburgh

quote: Joy is a net of love by which you can catch souls.
author: Mother Teresa

quote: If someone thinks that love and peace is a cliche that must have been left behind in the Sixties, that's his problem. Love and peace are eternal.
author: John Lennon

quote: The first duty of love is to listen.
author: Paul Tillich

quote: I see when men love women. They give them but a little of their lives. But women when they love give everything.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Work is love made visible. And if you cannot work with love but only with distaste, it is better that you should leave your work and sit at the gate of the temple and take alms of those who work with joy.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: There are four questions of value in life... What is sacred? Of what is the spirit made? What is worth living for, and what is worth dying for? The answer to each is the same. Only love.
author: Johnny Depp

quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

quote: Power is of two kinds. One is obtained by the fear of punishment and the other by acts of love. Power based on love is a thousand times more effective and permanent then the one derived from fear of punishment.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: We are not the same persons this year as last nor are those we love. It is a happy chance if we, changing, continue to love a changed person.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: Falling in love and having a relationship are two different things.
author: Keanu Reeves

quote: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your heart.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: As selfishness and complaint pervert the mind, so love with its joy clears and sharpens the vision.
author: Helen Keller

quote: When you fish for love, bait with your heart, not your brain.
author: Mark Twain

quote: I love deadlines. I like the whooshing sound they make as they fly by.
author: Douglas Adams

quote: Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

quote: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Love is like a virus. It can happen to anybody at any time.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: It has always seemed strange to me... the things we admire in men, kindness and generosity, openness, honesty, understanding and feeling, are the concomitants of failure in our system. And those traits we detest, sharpness, greed, acquisitiveness, meanness, egotism and self-interest, are the traits of success. And while men admire the quality of the first they love the produce of the second.
author: John Steinbeck

quote: Love one another and help others to rise to the higher levels, simply by pouring out love. Love is infectious and the greatest healing energy.
author: Sai Baba

quote: Christmas, my child, is love in action. Every time we love, every time we give, it's Christmas.
author: Dale Evans

quote: We never know the love of a parent till we become parents ourselves.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: I love the man that can smile in trouble, that can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but he whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves his conduct, will pursue his principles unto death.
author: Thomas Paine

quote: Love is a serious mental disease.
author: Plato

quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: I love those who yearn for the impossible.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Love to faults is always blind, always is to joy inclined. Lawless, winged, and unconfined, and breaks all chains from every mind.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: What does love look like? It has the hands to help others. It has the feet to hasten to the poor and needy. It has eyes to see misery and want. It has the ears to hear the sighs and sorrows of men. That is what love looks like.
author: Saint Augustine

quote: The sadness of the women's movement is that they don't allow the necessity of love. See, I don't personally trust any revolution where love is not allowed.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Love. Fall in love and stay in love. Write only what you love, and love what you write. The key word is love. You have to get up in the morning and write something you love, something to live for.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: I love life because what more is there?
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: Where we love is home - home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quote: Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: Show me your hands. Do they have scars from giving? Show me your feet. Are they wounded in service? Show me your heart. Have you left a place for divine love?
author: Fulton J. Sheen

quote: Once in his life, every man is entitled to fall madly in love with a gorgeous redhead.
author: Lucille Ball

quote: All, everything that I understand, I understand only because I love.
author: Leo Tolstoy

quote: Knowledge is love and light and vision.
author: Helen Keller

quote: Love sought is good, but given unsought, is better.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: I guess I have always been deeply terrified to really be someone's wife since I know from life one cannot love another, ever, really.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Who could refrain that had a heart to love and in that heart courage to make love known?
author: William Shakespeare

quote: The game of basketball has been everything to me. My place of refuge, place I've always gone where I needed comfort and peace. It's been the site of intense pain and the most intense feelings of joy and satisfaction. It's a relationship that has evolved over time, given me the greatest respect and love for the game.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: I have a very strong feeling that the opposite of love is not hate - it's apathy. It's not giving a damn.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: We can't command our love, but we can our actions.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle

quote: One advantage of marriage is that, when you fall out of love with him or he falls out of love with you, it keeps you together until you fall in again.
author: Judith Viorst

quote: If you want to be successful, it's just this simple. Know what you are doing. Love what you are doing. And believe in what you are doing.
author: Will Rogers

quote: Politics is such a torment that I advise everyone I love not to mix with it.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Justice that love gives is a surrender, justice that law gives is a punishment.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: Find joy in everything you choose to do. Every job, relationship, home... it's your responsibility to love it, or change it.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: Speak low, if you speak love.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: I'm not claiming divinity. I've never claimed purity of soul. I've never claimed to have the answers to life. I only put out songs and answer questions as honestly as I can... But I still believe in peace, love and understanding.
author: John Lennon

quote: True love doesn't happen right away it's an ever-growing process. It develops after you've gone through many ups and downs, when you've suffered together, cried together, laughed together.
author: Ricardo Montalban

quote: This is one of the miracles of love: It gives a power of seeing through its own enchantments and yet not being disenchanted.
author: C. S. Lewis

quote: The best smell in the world is that man that you love.
author: Jennifer Aniston

quote: Love one another, but make not a bond of love: Let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love is blind friendship closes its eyes.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Love never dies a natural death. It dies because we don't know how to replenish it's source. It dies of blindness and errors and betrayals. It dies of illness and wounds it dies of weariness, of witherings, of tarnishings.
author: Anais Nin

quote: I do all the evil I can before I learn to shun it? Is it not enough to know the evil to shun it? If not, we should be sincere enough to admit that we love evil too well to give it up.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: Love is too young to know what conscience is.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: What light is to the eyes - what air is to the lungs - what love is to the heart, liberty is to the soul of man.
author: Robert Green Ingersoll

quote: Love will find a way through paths where wolves fear to prey.
author: Lord Byron

quote: A friendship that like love is warm A love like friendship, steady.
author: Thomas Moore

quote: Respect is what we owe love, what we give.
author: Philip James Bailey

quote: Love is not love that alters when it alteration finds.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: All you need is love.
author: John Lennon

quote: Women love us for our defects. If we have enough of them, they will forgive us everything, even our gigantic intellects.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: No matter how dark the moment, love and hope are always possible.
author: George Chakiris

quote: When a man has once loved a woman he will do anything for her except continue to love her.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Hatred is blind, as well as love.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Who will tell whether one happy moment of love or the joy of breathing or walking on a bright morning and smelling the fresh air, is not worth all the suffering and effort which life implies.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Love cannot save you from your own fate.
author: Jim Morrison

quote: Love is the answer, and you know that for sure Love is a flower, you've got to let it grow.
author: John Lennon

quote: If we love our country, we should also love our countrymen.
author: Ronald Reagan

quote: They do not love that do not show their love.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Man's nature is not essentially evil. Brute nature has been know to yield to the influence of love. You must never despair of human nature.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: There is always something ridiculous about the emotions of people whom one has ceased to love.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: I'm an introvert... I love being by myself, love being outdoors, love taking a long walk with my dogs and looking at the trees, flowers, the sky.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: Presents don't really mean much to me. I don't want to sound mawkish, but - it was the realization that I have a great many people in my life who really love me, and who I really love.
author: Gabriel Byrne

quote: Flatter me, and I may not believe you. Criticize me, and I may not like you. Ignore me, and I may not forgive you. Encourage me, and I will not forget you. Love me and I may be forced to love you.
author: William Arthur Ward

quote: Is it not enough to know the evil to shun it? If not, we should be sincere enough to admit that we love evil too well to give it up.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: Love is never lost. If not reciprocated, it will flow back and soften and purify the heart.
author: Washington Irving

quote: Do you know what it means to come home at night to a woman who'll give you a little love, a little affection, a little tenderness? It means you're in the wrong house, that's what it means.
author: Henny Youngman

quote: Yesterday we obeyed kings and bent our necks before emperors. But today we kneel only to truth, follow only beauty, and obey only love.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: The mother-child relationship is paradoxical and, in a sense, tragic. It requires the most intense love on the mother's side, yet this very love must help the child grow away from the mother, and to become fully independent.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Ever has it been that love knows not its own depth until the hour of separation.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Throw your dreams into space like a kite, and you do not know what it will bring back, a new life, a new friend, a new love, a new country.
author: Anais Nin

quote: Love is trembling happiness.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Even when I'm old and grey, I won't be able to play it, but I'll still love the game.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: Don't do anything by half. If you love someone, love them with all your soul. When you go to work, work your ass off. When you hate someone, hate them until it hurts.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Love and doubt have never been on speaking terms.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: A dog is the only thing on earth that loves you more than you love yourself.
author: Josh Billings

quote: Doing what you love is the cornerstone of having abundance in your life.
author: Wayne Dyer

quote: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that is the stuff life is made of.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: Money can't buy love, but it improves your bargaining position.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Do not hire a man who does your work for money, but him who does it for love of it.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: I wish people would love everybody else the way they love me. It would be a better world.
author: Muhammad Ali

quote: Age does not protect you from love. But love, to some extent, protects you from age.
author: Anais Nin

quote: I'll love you, dear, I'll love you till China and Africa meet and the river jumps over the mountain and the salmon sing in the street.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: If you cannot work with love but only with distaste, it is better that you should leave your work.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love is the expression of one's values, the greatest reward you can earn for the moral qualities you have achieved in your character and person, the emotional price paid by one man for the joy he receives from the virtues of another.
author: Ayn Rand

quote: Personally, I just think rap music is the best thing out there, period. If you look at my deck in my car radio, you're always going to find a hip-hop tape that's all I buy, that's all I live, that's all I listen to, that's all I love.
author: Eminem

quote: Success comes from taking the initiative and following up... persisting... eloquently expressing the depth of your love. What simple action could you take today to produce a new momentum toward success in your life?
author: Tony Robbins

quote: I swear, by my life and my love of it, that I will never live for the sake of another man, nor ask another man to live for mine.
author: Ayn Rand

quote: Where there's marriage without love, there will be love without marriage.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: I love to be alone. I never found the companion that was so companionable as solitude.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: He who falls in love with himself will have no rivals.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: The story of life is quicker then the blink of an eye, the story of love is hello, goodbye.
author: Jimi Hendrix

quote: When people get married because they think it's a long-time love affair, they'll be divorced very soon, because all love affairs end in disappointment. But marriage is a recognition of a spiritual identity.
author: Joseph Campbell

quote: Love and work are the cornerstones of our humanness.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: When love beckons to you, follow him, Though his ways are hard and steep. And when his wings enfold you yield to him, Though the sword hidden among his pinions may wound you.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Coming generations will learn equality from poverty, and love from woes.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Mother's love is peace. It need not be acquired, it need not be deserved.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: If a man walks in the woods for love of them half of each day, he is in danger of being regarded as a loafer. But if he spends his days as a speculator, shearing off those woods and making the earth bald before her time, he is deemed an industrious and enterprising citizen.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: The two most misused words in the entire English vocabulary are love and friendship. A true friend would die for you, so when you start trying to count them on one hand, you don't need any fingers.
author: Larry Flynt

quote: There is always some madness in love. But there is also always some reason in madness.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: There is no love without forgiveness, and there is no forgiveness without love.
author: Bryant H. McGill

quote: Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
author: Joseph Addison

quote: I know you've heard it a thousand times before. But it's true - hard work pays off. If you want to be good, you have to practice, practice, practice. If you don't love something, then don't do it.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: One is very crazy when in love.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
author: Benjamin Britten

quote: Men love to wonder, and that is the seed of science.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Do what you love. Know your own bone gnaw at it, bury it, unearth it, and gnaw it still.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: Anxiety is love's greatest killer. It makes others feel as you might when a drowning man holds on to you. You want to save him, but you know he will strangle you with his panic.
author: Anais Nin

quote: Guilt for being rich, and guilt thinking that perhaps love and peace isn't enough and you have to go and get shot or something.
author: John Lennon

quote: I have found that if you love life, life will love you back.
author: Arthur Rubinstein

quote: Truth is handsomer than the affectation of love. Your goodness must have some edge to it, else it is none.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Because of a great love, one is courageous.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: There is not enough love and goodness in the world to permit giving any of it away to imaginary beings.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: I have no hostility to nature, but a child's love to it. I expand and live in the warm day like corn and melons.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: For though we love both the truth and our friends, piety requires us to honor the truth first.
author: Aristotle
